final:
-- Phase 2: swap the first and last elements of a list in place.
-- The list is mutated through a var parameter; the caller passes &xs.

ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex ends_swapped([5, 9]) == [9, 5]
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  var ys = copy xs
  if ys.len() >= 2
    let last = ys.len() - 1
    let a = ys[0]
    ys[0] = ys[last]
    ys[last] = a
  ys

swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  if xs.len() >= 2
    let last = xs.len() - 1
    let a = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[last]
    xs[last] = a

test_swap_ends() =
  var v = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&v)
  assert v == [3, 2, 1]
  var one = [7]
  swap_ends(&one)
  assert one == [7]
